data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 140.2m (2016: GBP 102.4m) is a deterioration of GBP 19.1m (2016: deterioration of GBP 2.8m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to unfavourable developments on Professional Lines and Energy with partially offsetting favourable developments across the other classes.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 36.585 million, representing 11.28% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This was primarily driven by adverse claims development on Professional Lines, Property, and Non-Marine Liability accounts, as well as unfavourable developments on Energy and late reporting developments on legacy lines from 2013 & Prior. These adverse movements were partially offset by favourable developments across other classes such as Political Risks, Satellites, and Marine Liability.
